inventory.default: Read-only known database/configuration scan, no uploaded-file bytes or network
inventory.logicalIdentity: Resolved saved/legacy disk name plus stored path; aliases not physically merged
inventory.verification: Streamed SHA-256 and byte count per eligible logical object, source/config re-scan afterward
inventory.flags: Schema/JSON/metadata/locator/conflict problems; missing/wrong-owner/hash-mismatching task links; missing/changed/unreadable bytes and detected drift
inventory.outputPrivacy: Summary by default; optional internal record locators/codes, no paths/filenames/document hashes/private notes/content

dependencies: Composer/lock/all vendor files unchanged from v0.30.0
limits: Inventory covers known upload records/retained metadata in eight portal source families, not other applications, directory/bucket contents, unregistered storage objects or a complete backup. Missing/incompatible schema returns checks rather than an apparently successful empty result.

Logical object identity is configured disk name plus stored path. Repeated references at the same logical location are deduplicated; distinct aliases of one physical location are not merged. Declared bytes are not actual storage/billing/backup usage.

Default mode reads database metadata/configuration without uploaded-file/network access. Explicit file verification may read private/S3 bytes and compares SHA-256 and declared size. Invalid/conflicting/missing/changed/unreadable references are not repaired or adopted.

The report is a live read-only scan, not a transactionally frozen or signed immutable manifest. Optional verification re-scans metadata/storage identity after reading files and flags detected drift; matching bindings do not certify ongoing consistency.

Neither bytes verification nor report status approves migration, restores a withdrawn source, authenticates signatures or establishes assessment/funding/compliance. No file, saved snapshot, disk pin, record or audit is written/relinked/deleted by the inventory.

Actual source/target aliases, missing/legacy file rescue, unregistered-file reconciliation, controlled verified copy/relink and restore/deployment still need Martin’s repository/environment. No actual Cloud bucket/database or real learner files used.

Native database proof is local MariaDB 11.8.6/PDO MySQL, not Oracle MySQL or the exact managed Cloud engine. Actual engine/version/collation/TLS/schema and browser/backup/load acceptance remain separate.
No new dependency or migration. Existing staging/bootstrap/scheduling stay opt-in/off by default and production remains blocked. No real data, credentials, external messages or Cloud deployment used.
